title.narrative: MSME Envelope Banpais WSME WCS II

description.narrative: Project Outcome - Stakeholder effects: Improved access to finance for MEs: Through the Project, IFC will support Banpais to increase access to finance for MEs and WOE. It is expected that this in turn will preserve jobs and enterprise growth by supporting working capital needs of MEs reducing the SME and WSME finance gap in Honduras. Market Creation: Estimated to be strong based on a meaningful movement in an underdeveloped market.

The proposed investment consists of a US$50 million working capital loan to Banco del País, S.A. (Banpais or the Bank) in Honduras. The proposed loan will have a 2-year tenor with the renewal option for an additional 2-year tenor for a maximum tenor of 4 years. The purpose of the proposed IFC investment is to support Banpais lending program to Medium Enterprises (MEs), with a carve-out of at least 25% for including Women-owned Medium Enterprises (WOE) (the Project). The Project is part of a country envelope of up to US$155 million (jointly for Honduras and Nicaragua) that will be supported by a pooled first loss guarantee of up to US$38.75 million provided by International Development Agency IDA Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (IDA-PSW BFF).
